messages.text: The partner portal (HOR-7) is blocked until auth-service supports the client credentials grant (HOR-8). <@U12345XYZ> what is your ETA?

Noted. Alex is a single point of failure for both Triton GA and Horizon. Let us find a second engineer for auth-service.

Two partners asked for Ed25519 signatures. I will put it in the backlog for after GA.
